summary: items2dict parameters: required list of dicts, plus key_name and value_name to use different field names.
questions: How do I use items2dict when my list uses Name and Value fields?

answer_card.title: items2dict parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (list of dict, required): each dict must have the key and value fields
- `key_name` (default `key`): field holding the destination key
- `value_name` (default `value`): field holding the destination value
